chunks: They will say: 'In fact, it is you who will have no welcome. It is you who brought this upon us. What an evil place of rest!'

key_terms.قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ: You brought it upon us / You preceded us

ai.seo_question: What do the leaders say to their followers in Hell according to Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Sad, the dialogue in Hell illustrates the mutual recrimination between leaders and followers, highlighting that while leaders initiated the misguidance, the followers actively chose to follow them. Shia scholars emphasize this reciprocal accountability, noting that the 'evil place of rest' (bi'sa al-qarar) signifies a permanent abode where both parties share the consequence of their collective choice, yet the leaders bear the primary burden of guidance. This exchange serves as a practical warning against blind imitation (taqlid) and underscores the individual responsibility for one's spiritual path.
